_ghi_chu: Van ban quan ly nha nuoc ve the duc the thao va quy dinh chuyen mon hien tren trang /van-ban (muc 'Van ban quan ly the thao'). Moi muc: so, ngay (yyyy-mm-dd), trichYeu, coQuan, pdf (ten tep trong data/docs, khong dau), trang (so trang cua PDF), ghiChu (CHI ghi dieu da neu trong chinh van ban, vd ngay co hieu luc; de "" neu khong co). Sap xep: moi nhat truoc. KHONG ghi tinh trang 'con hieu luc' khi chua doi chieu co so du lieu phap luat chinh thuc. Them van ban: chep PDF vao data/docs roi them mot muc o day, sau do node build.mjs.
